# Postman Collection Builder Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > Postman

## Overview

Creates organized Postman collections with proper folder structure, request documentation, and variable management for API testing

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [postman-collection-builder-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
postman-collection-builder-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@postman-collection-builder` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design collection folder structure by feature
- Configure collection variables and environments
- Add request documentation with examples
- Implement pre-request and test scripts

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Collection Organization**: Folder structure and naming conventions
- **Variables**: Collection, environment, and global variables
- **Documentation**: Request and response documentation
